All the colors its like… like a rainbow.|The stormtrooper and an undercover Kanan Jarrus|}} A '''Stormtrooper Commander''' of the [[Galactic Empire]]'s [[Stormtrooper Corps]] was stationed on [[Lothal]] during the [[Empire Day]] celebration in [[4 BBY]], at which he was deceived by a performance by [[Kanan Jarrus]] and [[Ezra Bridger]]. ==Biography== [[File:EzraKananFastOne-EmpireDay.png|thumb|300px|left|Bridger and Kanan were able to fool the stormtrooper pretending to be a son and his intoxicated father.]] Stationed on the [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]] world of Lothal in [[4 BBY]], the [[stormtrooper]] served as a [[Stormtrooper Commander]] during the [[Empire Day]] celebration. He and a number of Imperial troops had been searching for the [[Rodian]] fugitive [[Tseebo]], who had absconded with secret information. While [[Sabine Wren]] and [[Garazeb Orrelios]] were distracting the crowd by hurling fireworks high up towards the sky, the commander was stationed at his post when he spotted [[Spectres|Spectre]] [[Kanan Jarrus]], who had just snuck under a [[TIE/ad v1]] by planting an explosive and tried to sneak away. He threatened to arrest Kanan since this area was off limits, but Kanan managed to fool the him by pretending that he was a drunk Imperial patriot excited by all the fireworks. When [[Ezra Bridger]] found Kanan and played along as his "son," the stormtrooper allowed them to leave. ==Equipment== The stormtrooper wore [[Stormtrooper armor|armor]] typical of his organization. Despite his role as a Stormtrooper Commander, however, he did not wear any type of command [[pauldron]]. {{Char-stub}} ==Behind the scenes== The stormtrooper is voiced by [[Steve Blum]], who voiced [[Garazeb Orrelios]] in the television series ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]'' [[Star Wars Rebels Season One|Season One]]. ==Appearances== *{{Rebels|Empire Day (episode)}} {{1st}} *''[[Ezra's Duel with Danger]]'' ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals with he/him pronouns]] [[Category:Males]] [[Category:Stormtrooper Commanders]] [[Category:Stormtroopers of the Galactic Empire]]
